fluff.overview: The Quicksilver Mongoose is a unique Clan-era battleship, the product of Clan Mongoose's ambitious reconstruction of a captured Du Shi Wang-class hull. Completed in 2844, the rebuild was so comprehensive that the resulting vessel bore virtually no resemblance to its Inner Sphere ancestor, warranting an entirely new class designation. Commissioned as Clan Mongoose's flagship, the Quicksilver Mongoose gave the Clan a genuine capital WarShip capability and served as one of the more remarkable examples of Golden Century naval engineering. As a one-of-a-kind vessel rather than a production class, the Quicksilver Mongoose occupied a singular place among the early Clan fleets, its very existence a reflection of the ambition and resourcefulness that characterized Clan Mongoose's approach to naval warfare during the formative decades following the founding of the Clans.
fluff.capabilities:
At 900,000 tons and 870 meters in length, the Quicksilver Mongoose ranks among the most powerful WarShips produced during the Golden Century. The rebuild retained the Du Shi Wang's massive structural frame, rated at an exceptional 150 points of structural integrity, while replacing virtually every other system with Clan-specification equipment. Twenty-seven hundred double heat sinks manage the extraordinary thermal load generated by the vessel's all-energy weapons battery.

The nose mounts a devastating concentration of eight heavy naval PPCs and four medium naval PPCs, giving the Quicksilver Mongoose one of the most powerful forward batteries of any vessel its size. Each forward quarter carries four NL45 naval lasers alongside Clan pulse laser point defense batteries. The broadsides mount four NL45 naval lasers and three light naval PPCs per side, providing formidable firepower across the beam. The aft quarters mirror the forward quarter configuration with four NL45 naval lasers each, while two medium naval PPCs and pulse laser batteries protect the stern. Every arc features integrated Clan small and large pulse laser batteries for comprehensive anti-fighter defense.

Improved ferro-aluminum armor provides excellent protection relative to its weight. Two gravity decks of 150 and 70 meters serve the crew. Fifty aerospace fighters deployed from a single large bay with six doors give the battleship substantial strike and screening capability. Two docking collars accommodate DropShips for ground operations. Over 106,000 tons of cargo capacity across two holds supports extended independent operations far from established supply lines, well suited to a Clan flagship operating in the Deep Periphery.
fluff.deployment:
The Quicksilver Mongoose began its existence as the CCS Jasmine Liao, a Du Shi Wang-class battleship in service with the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. The vessel was captured by the Star League Defense Force during one of the numerous border conflicts of the Star League era and pressed into SLDF service. When General Aleksandr Kerensky led the Exodus fleet into the Deep Periphery in 2784, the former Capellan battleship accompanied the fleet.

Following the founding of the Clans by Nicholas Kerensky, the aging Du Shi Wang hull was allocated to Clan Mongoose. Recognizing both the hull's potential and its obsolescence, Clan Mongoose's naval engineers undertook a comprehensive reconstruction beginning around 2840, completing the work by 2844. The rebuilt vessel was christened Quicksilver Mongoose and commissioned as the Clan's flagship.

The Quicksilver Mongoose met its fate at the Battle of Circe in 2868, one of the defining naval engagements of the inter-Clan conflicts. During the battle, the Quicksilver Mongoose engaged and crippled the Smoke Jaguar McKenna-class battleship CSJ Obsidian before itself being crippled by the Smoke Jaguar vessel CSJ Storm Cat. With Clan Mongoose unable to repair the extensive damage, the stricken battleship was seized by Clan Smoke Jaguar as a prize of war and placed in mothballs at Strana Mechty. The vessel reportedly remained in storage well into the thirty-first century, the last surviving example of Du Shi Wang lineage in any form.
fluff.history:
The hull that became the Quicksilver Mongoose had a long history before Clan Mongoose ever received it. Originally a Du Shi Wang-class battleship constructed by the Capellan Confederation, the vessel served multiple masters over the centuries, passing through Star League Defense Force control before ultimately joining General Kerensky's Exodus fleet in 2784. By the time the Clans were formally established on the Pentagon worlds, the Du Shi Wang hull was centuries old and thoroughly obsolete.

Clan Mongoose received the aging hull as part of the post-Exodus naval allocation. Where other Clans might have relegated such an antique to scrap, Clan Mongoose's naval engineers recognized that the hull's massive structural frame remained sound and could serve as the foundation for an entirely new WarShip. Beginning around 2840, the Clan undertook a comprehensive reconstruction, stripping the hull to its frame and rebuilding it from the keel up with Clan-specification equipment. The work was completed in 2844, producing a vessel so thoroughly transformed that it warranted an entirely new class designation rather than being considered a mere refit of its Capellan predecessor.

The rebuilt Quicksilver Mongoose immediately became Clan Mongoose's flagship and most potent naval asset. Armed with a formidable all-energy capital weapons battery and carrying a substantial fighter complement, the battleship gave Clan Mongoose a genuine power projection capability that few of the smaller Clans could match. For over two decades, the vessel served as the Clan's primary naval deterrent, and its presence in a system was generally sufficient to discourage challenges to Clan Mongoose's territorial holdings during the Golden Century.

The Quicksilver Mongoose's active career ended at the Battle of Circe in 2868, one of the most significant naval engagements of the inter-Clan conflicts. The battleship was crippled during the fighting, and Clan Mongoose lacked the shipyard capacity to effect repairs. Clan Smoke Jaguar claimed the stricken vessel as a prize of war and placed it in mothballs at Strana Mechty, where it remained in storage for centuries. The Quicksilver Mongoose reportedly survived well into the thirty-first century as the last known vessel of Du Shi Wang lineage in any form, a quiet monument to Clan Mongoose's engineering ambition and to the inter-Clan warfare that ultimately consumed the Clan itself.
